policy: Optional, simultaneously visible anatomical estimates. Region boundaries are atlas-derived reference anatomy, not patient targets, seed extents, electric fields or efficacy maps.

regions.name: dmPFC
regions.description: The non-orbital medial superior frontal labels in AAL3 provide a bounded gross-anatomical estimate of dmPFC. The anterior SMA is a separate region with a separate color.
regions.limitations: Reference anatomy in the AAL3 MNI single-subject template, displayed using its native affine. The background cortex uses a different MNI template; small mismatches are possible. No new nonlinear registration, individual treatment boundary or electric field is claimed. This broad medial prefrontal proxy includes anterior medial cortex and is not a unique cytoarchitectonic dmPFC definition. Dunlop’s connectivity seed and Talairach coil landmark do not define its extent.
regions.evidence_note: Studied in OCD and depression. The 120-patient Dunlop 2020 depression trial found no superiority over sham. The seed shown here comes from the OCD paper only.

regions.name: DLPFC
regions.description: Middle-frontal parcels provide broad DLPFC reference anatomy. Use Hemisphere to compare sides; laterality and location vary by protocol.
regions.limitations: These gyri are an approximation, not a cytoarchitectonic DLPFC boundary, individual coil location or electric field.
regions.evidence_note: DLPFC is represented in depression and OCD TMS studies. Clinical evidence retains its reported laterality; optional anatomy layers are independent.

regions.name: Pre-SMA
regions.description: Pre-SMA is estimated from the left and right AAL3 supplementary motor labels anterior to the anterior-commissure plane (MNI y > 0). This separates it from both SMA proper and the medial superior-frontal estimate of dmPFC.
regions.limitations: Reference anatomy in the AAL3 MNI single-subject template, displayed using its native affine. The background cortex uses a different MNI template; small mismatches are possible. No new nonlinear registration, individual treatment boundary or electric field is claimed. The anterior-SMA rule follows the anatomical part of Ji 2021’s method. Its patient-specific 15 mm superficial restriction and connectivity-based target selection are not reproduced.
regions.evidence_note: OCD TMS literature includes bilateral scalp-based targeting and left pre-SMA targeting. Ji 2021 used individualized connectivity-guided sites, not one universal coordinate.

regions.name: VLPFC
regions.description: Inferior-frontal parcels provide broad VLPFC context. They include opercular, triangular and orbital portions; the whole region is not an amygdala-specific target.
regions.limitations: No study-specific VLPFC–amygdala tract, target mask or electric field is available. “More amygdala-connected” is not a demonstrated quantitative ranking of all targets. No connection-strength overlay is inferred.
regions.evidence_note: Sydnor 2022 showed left-VLPFC TMS engagement of the amygdala in 45 healthy participants: mechanistic background, not a depression/OCD efficacy trial. Oathes 2023 used an amygdala-connected VLPFC comparison site in depression circuit probing; its evoked amygdala response did not predict depression change. Existing OCD DBS cards concern connected cortex, not direct VLPFC stimulation.

regions.name: sgACC
regions.description: Left and right subgenual anterior cingulate gray matter follow the AAL3 ACC_sub labels. The region is displayed as a shaded surface, independently of Fox’s analysis seed.
regions.limitations: Reference anatomy in the AAL3 MNI single-subject template, displayed using its native affine. The background cortex uses a different MNI template; small mismatches are possible. No new nonlinear registration, individual treatment boundary or electric field is claimed. This gray-matter region does not represent the adjacent SCC white-matter DBS target.
regions.evidence_note: “Subglossal” is interpreted here as subgenual. Depression TMS literature uses sgACC as a network reference; the separate SCC DBS view concerns subcallosal white matter. These are not interchangeable targets.

regions.name: OFC
regions.description: Medial and lateral orbitofrontal parcels plus pars orbitalis provide reference anatomy. Use Hemisphere to inspect either side.
regions.limitations: Anatomical OFC parcels do not define a stimulation field. The medial/lateral distinction and stimulation-versus-imaging-effect laterality remain finding-specific.
regions.evidence_note: OCD literature includes OFC stimulation and OFC connections of DBS sites. Nauczyciel’s stimulation was right-sided; the reported metabolic decrease was bilateral.

regions.name: Right OFC
regions.description: Right OFC is a documented OCD TMS target. Nauczyciel used the Fp2 scalp landmark; the colored parcels show anatomy, not that coil placement.
regions.limitations: The recalled “right bitemporofrontal/bifrontal cortex” name remains unresolved. Right OFC is a plausible match, not a confirmed correction. No separate region is created under the uncertain name.
regions.evidence_note: The cited right-OFC trial did not reach significance in its primary active-versus-sham clinical comparison. Bilateral PET changes are separate from the right stimulation site.
